title: Saturn and Its Rings (Cassini)
explanation: Cassini captured this natural-colour view of Saturn's rings just before its Grand Finale in 2017.

title: Jupiter's Great Red Spot (Juno)
explanation: Juno's JunoCam captured Jupiter's iconic Great Red Spot — an anticyclonic storm wider than Earth.

title: Mars Valles Marineris
explanation: Viking Orbiter mosaic of Valles Marineris — more than 4,000 km long, dwarfing the Grand Canyon.

title: Pluto in True Colour (New Horizons)
explanation: New Horizons captured this true-colour image of Pluto on 14 July 2015, revealing the iconic heart-shaped Tombaugh Regio.

title: Enceladus Water Plumes (Cassini)
explanation: Cassini discovered active water-ice geysers erupting from the south pole of Saturn's moon Enceladus.
